markets.name: REWE
markets.note: anchor blocked; recon 2026-07-02: requests GET shop.rewe.de/ = 403 (Cloudflare WAF on plain HTTP). Playwright headless chromium gets past that initial layer (real SPA shell loads, title 'REWE Onlineshop Lebensmittel...', ecommerce-api.rewe.de reachable); PLZ/market endpoints (api/marketselection/zipcodes/{plz}, .../services, .../services/pickup, api/timeslots/pickup/{marketId}/next-bookable) return real 200 JSON. But committing a delivery or pickup market selection (POST .../userselections) -- or even just following the 'Zu den Marktangeboten' offers link into a category -- triggers a Cloudflare Turnstile interstitial ('Nur einen Moment...' / 'Zeig uns, dass du ein Mensch bist') in the large majority of attempts (~1 in 10 slipped through, to /shop/api/category-search, which is category-navigation metadata only -- id/name/link/productCount, no prices/names/barcodes, not product data). No real per-product JSON was retrievable within the recon budget, so no fixture was captured/fabricated. Re-enable once reachable (e.g. anti-bot service / residential proxy).
